correctness.rationale: Read source reduced Riccati map and reconstructed w_{n+1}=exp(−iχ_n)(w_n+s)/(1+s w_n), with s=sinθ∈(0,1). The disk-automorphism identity 1−|f_s(w)|²=(1−s²)(1−|w|²)/|1+sw|² gives exact log defect telescope. Fresh independent numerical identity/Jensen checks at 9 complex configurations plus Haar quadratures succeeded. Since each χ_n is fresh uniform and independent, postrotation angle is Haar and independent of new radius except at f_s(w)=0; w=−s maps to 0 then next step nonzero and Haar. Angular uniformity yields E[log|1+s w_n| conditional on radius]=0, bounded increment in [log(1−s),log(1+s)]; martingale strong law gives almost-sure 2log cosθ and Hoeffding–Azuma gives displayed two-sided n−1 tail bound with L=log[(1+s)/(1−s)]. Simulations do not prove the infinite limit.
